scenes.headline: How linear attention untangles overlapping voices
scenes.sub: FLASepformer's gated focused attention, and JAEC's echo canceller.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Marmalade! Alibaba shipped two speech front ends: one pulls overlapping voices apart, one cancels echo. Here's how they work.

scenes.text: FLASepformer keeps two published separation networks and swaps only their global attention for Gated Focused Linear Attention, whose cost grows linearly with audio length.
scenes.say: The idea: keep two published separation networks, and swap only their attention for a kind whose cost grows linearly with audio length.

scenes.title: One reordering, from quadratic to linear
scenes.say: Attention scores every pair of frames before weighting the values.

parts.note: N x N pair scores: quadratic in audio length
parts.say: At two thousand frames a second, that pair matrix grows with the square of the length.

parts.note: d x d, computed once, whatever the length
parts.say: Linear attention reorders the product. Keys times values is a small fixed matrix, computed once.

steps.note: focus: flat weights become sharp, softmax-like
steps.say: A focused kernel raises each query and key feature to the power three, then rescales it. Flat weights turn sharp, like softmax.

steps.note: rank: the convolution lifts the low-rank ceiling
steps.say: Linear weights are low rank, so rows blur together. A depthwise convolution over time, kernel seven, adds local detail back.
The paper's own addition is a gate: a norm, a linear layer and an activation, letting each frame down-weight the global branch.

scenes.title: JAEC: an echo canceller in stages

items.say: The echo canceller's neural delay estimator finds the lag between the far-end reference and the echo in the microphone.
An adaptive linear filter models the room and subtracts the predicted echo.
A full canceller adds a neural suppressor for what the filter misses. This release leaves that stage out.

scenes.title: SDRi by checkpoint and benchmark
scenes.note: the gap is mostly the benchmark, not the architecture
scenes.say: The released checkpoint scores twenty point seven decibels on its own benchmark. The quoted twenty-four point nine is a bigger model on an easier one.

scenes.text: Reordering one matrix product makes attention linear; focus, a convolution and a gate buy back the accuracy.

recap: One attention module swapped, nothing else
Focus sharpens, convolution restores rank, a gate weighs it
JAEC ships delay estimation and a linear filter
scenes.say: To recap: reorder the product, sharpen it, restore its rank, gate it. And the echo canceller ships two stages of three.
